text:
Google acquired the cloud-security firm Wiz to close a security gap with competitors AWS and Azure, betting that cloud-security consolidation would be the next battleground in the "cloud wars" driven by AI-driven cloud adoption [Source: ev-1].

The deal signaled a major shift toward consolidation in the cloud-security market. Announced on March 18, 2025, for approximately $32 billion in cash, it represented Google's largest acquisition ever [Source: ev-1]. The transaction followed Wiz’s rejection of an earlier $23 billion offer from Google in July 2024 [Source: ev-1].
